undetermined_behaviors: The spec does not determine the relative order of jobs that share the same priority value; it only requires higher-priority jobs to precede lower-priority ones. This implementation makes the concrete choice of keeping equal-priority jobs in their original submission order (a stable descending sort). Probes 1, 3, 4, 6, and 7 each contain at least one priority tie, so on those probes a different spec-conforming implementation could legitimately order the tied ids differently.
notes: Implementation is a stable sort by descending integer priority, using only the 'id' and 'priority' fields named in spec.md. Outputs were hand-traced from the code: within each probe, jobs were bucketed by priority (descending) with submission order preserved inside each bucket.
